name: htmx-php-builder
description: Builds memory-first HTMX + PHP + Bootstrap 5.3 applications with a consistent design system, a fixed phased build order, an Ask Me Anything feature in every app, and — by default — a fit to the MaluDB Business OS kernel from the first commit (os-application), its schema designed against the estate's existing tables (one data model across the applications' separate databases)
